**Instructions:**

1. Form a group consisting of five (5) members.  
2. Collaborate with your group mates and satisfy the following requirements:

* Company name (dummy company only)  
* Company Background \- discuss a brief description of your company.  
* Provide different products (at least 30 products) and its descriptions offered by your company. Also, include all necessary information. (ex. price, categories, image, audio, video, etc.) *Note: Cite all your references*  
* Design your own company logo using any offline or online tools (note: save the logo file in appropriate file format)  
3. Develop a transaction-based system that will:

* Apply any programming language appropriate to achieve the objectives of your project	  
* Utilize a Microservice Architecture Framework  
* Provide different modules (eg. CLIENT SITE: Home, Registration, Products, Add to Cart, Payment, Admin Site : Add, Edit , Delete of product that will reflect to Client Side), the website should be published in FREE WEBSITE HOSTING SERVICES, and all that is applicable  
* Integrate creative and appropriate images, video or audio files as applicable  
* Apply consistent themes throughout the modules (uniform colors of design and navigation on each module); apply your knowledge and skills from your Human-Computer Interaction course)  
* Use appropriate input items (like text item, check box, etc)  
4. Be creative in designing your transaction-based system.   
5. Use appropriate filenames and proper naming conventions in saving your files and objects.  
6. Provide the codes you used in a two-column format. Properly use the correct filename and format   
7. Provide screenshots of each module running in a runtime environment.   
8. Provide additional modules that will display the developers’ profiles. (include latest picture and basic information)  
9. Make sure all modules are properly working without bugs or errors during runtime.  
10. **As a final requirement for this course, you will have to make an oral presentation and submit final documentation.**  
11. The final documentation will contain the following information ( see table of content)

1. **SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE AND OVERVIEW**  
   1. **High-Level System Diagram**

*![][image1]*

2. **Core Application Description** 

   RePIXL is an e-commerce website that specializes in selling preloved and brand-new vintage digital cameras. It allows customers to browse the product listing/catalog, search for their preferred brand, sort prices according to their budget, add items to their wishlist and cart, perform smooth transactions by using the most convenient payment method for the customer, and transparently locate their orders from the system updates. There are also additional features wherein the users can see if the product is in stock or out of stock, the number of purchases, and customer reviews before making a purchase. For the admin side, there will be a sidebar with features such as managing the product catalog, adding, editing, and removing products, updating product information and prices, monitoring stock availability, viewing the number of purchases, managing customer orders, tracking payment transactions, reviewing customer feedback and ratings, and managing customer accounts. The admin will also be able to monitor the overall sales and transactions of the website, update the status of orders, and ensure that the product information displayed to customers is accurate and up to date. These features are designed to provide both customers and administrators with a convenient, organized, and user-friendly experience while making the buying and selling process of vintage digital cameras more efficient, reliable, and transparent.

   3. **Detailed Module & Functionality Breakdown** 

      * Customer/Buyer Site (User-Facing) Modules & Functions 

        * Home Page & Discovery Module   
          **Purpose:** To serve as the main entry point of RePIXL and introduce users to the vintage digital camera marketplace.  
          **Functions:**   
> > > > > > - Display hero and featured content  
> > > > > > - Present featured camera listings  
> > > > > > - Display trust indicators such as verified sellers, condition-graded listings, secure checkout, and buyer protection  
> > > > > > - Provide navigation to major sections of the website  
> > > > > > - Introduce users to RePIXL’s vintage digital camera marketplace

  **Dependencies:** Product Catalog & Search Module


  * Product Catalog & Search Module   
    **Purpose:** To allow customers to browse and discover available vintage digital cameras.  
    **Functions:**   
> > > > > > - Display the available camera catalog  
> > > > > > - Browse cameras based on condition grade

> > > > > > - Browse cameras based on available specifications  
> > > > > > - Display basic product information  
> > > > > > - Provide navigation to individual camera details

  * Product Detail Module

> > > > > > - Display available product information

  * Cart Module

  * Wishlist/Saved Items Module
